description: This file defines a PHP trait 'LeaveRequestParamHelperTrait' that provides helper methods for processing leave request parameters within an API endpoint context. The trait includes methods for retrieving, validating, and assembling leave request parameters such as leave type, date ranges, comments, partial options, and durations, as well as defining validation rules for these parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeIdParam
methods.description: Retrieves the leave type ID from request parameters as an integer.

methods.name: getFromDateParam
methods.description: Retrieves the 'from' date as a DateTime object or null from request parameters.

methods.name: getToDateParam
methods.description: Retrieves the 'to' date as a DateTime object or null from request parameters.

methods.name: getCommentParam
methods.description: Retrieves the leave comment string or null from request parameters.

methods.name: getDurationParam
methods.description: Fetches an array representing duration details based on a key from request parameters.

methods.name: getPartialOptionParam
methods.description: Retrieves the partial day option as a string or null from request parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestParams
methods.description: Constructs a LeaveParameterObject using request parameters, validating and setting durations and partial options accordingly.

methods.name: setMultiDayPartialOptions
methods.description: Sets the partial day options and durations for multi-day leave requests based on request parameters.

methods.name: setSingleDayDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration for single-day leave requests based on generated duration.
